selection: One fixed candidate; no checkpoint selection on reserved checks.
improvement_gate: All seven corrected examples semantically correct after reload; numeric and general no worse than both parent and base; complete draft score greater than both on new cases.
release_gate: All targeted numeric and draft checks pass, plus broader deployment validation; this research alone cannot authorize release.
draft_rubric: Valid JSON summary/description strings and questions list of strings; all agreed constraints retained, no invented requirements or reopened settled questions. Semantically equivalent wording and logically entailed exclusions accepted. Manual non-blind assessment; no exact wording criterion.
limitations: Synthetic related families, not real-user or broad intelligence evidence; greedy diagnostic inference only. Old deep-check is now development.
